d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight, blunt-cut bangs and a smooth texture. Deep amethyst eyes with a calm, serene expression. Apparent age of twenty, possessing a youthful and graceful maturity. Slender and lithe build. A traditional Japanese white and red miko outfit featuring wide sleeves and a red hakama. A small gold circlet resting on the forehead and a floating mystical aura.
